depth_anything_v2.root_cause_analysis: ViT patch tokenization tends to smooth depth transitions across low-frequency walls and high-frequency silhouettes.
prescriptive_interventions: Loss formulation: Add edge-aware depth gradient loss (L_grad = |grad(d) - grad(d*)|) to penalize boundary bleeding.
Data augmentation: Apply random Perlin noise and CutBlur texture injection to force ViT to utilize geometric context over surface texture.
Inference post-processing: VEO-guided selective bilateral boundary filtering.

dpt_hybrid_midas.root_cause_analysis: Convolutional hybrid tokens suffer from specular highlight confounds, interpreting glossy floor reflections as deep virtual space.
prescriptive_interventions: Photometric loss masking: Apply HSV specular mask attenuation (V>200, S<40) during unsupervised photometric consistency.
Polarized synthetic training: Augment training splits with non-Lambertian synthetic rendering (e.g. Hypersim diffuse vs residual passes).
